releaseNotes: • Critical Fix: ARM64 MobileCLIP ONNX Model Fix — replaced unsupported dynamic-quantized `mobileclip_vision_q.onnx` (`ConvInteger(10)` ORT failure + corrupted cosine vectors) with native FP32 `mobileclip_vision.onnx` (~3x faster inference, true visual-text alignment, verified live on ARM64 Android 17) and lowered async CLIP scan interval to `600ms` for Nuvio/Stremio/CloudStream clothed kissing scenes.
